Blog post: 'What is prompt injection?'
Prompt injection is an attack where untrusted text contains phrases such as "ignore previous instructions" in the hope that a language model will treat them as commands. Defenses include separating data from instructions, least-privilege tools, and screening tool output. In this article we survey published attacks from 2023 to 2025.
